title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Entry Requirements by Product
content:
Each Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay product has an entry requirement on the ordering customer's Personal Sender Account level and on the details the destination must carry.

## Minimum account level and entry gate

| Product | Lowest Personal Sender Account level that may order | Further entry requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | Paloma Starter | none |
| Paloma Data Bundle | Paloma Starter | none |
| Paloma Electricity Token | Paloma Starter | a validated meter |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | Paloma Verified | a validated biller account |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | Paloma Starter | a validated biller account |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | Paloma Verified Plus | a student reference |

## Destination details

| Product | Destination number validated with the biller before submission | Destination holder's name required | Student reference number required | Payable from a Paloma Business account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | no | no | no | no |
| Paloma Data Bundle | no | no | no | no |
| Paloma Electricity Token | yes | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | yes | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | yes | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | yes | yes | yes | no |

## Notes to the tables

- For Paloma Bill Pay School Fees, the name recorded on the order is the student's name, and the student reference number is required as well.
- No product of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay may be paid from a Paloma Business account.
- For Paloma Airtime Top-Up and Paloma Data Bundle, the phone number is not validated before submission and no holder's name is required.

## Restated by product (hypothetical customers)

- A customer whose Personal Sender Account level is Paloma Starter meets the level requirement of Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle, Paloma Electricity Token and Paloma Bill Pay Television.
- A Paloma Bill Pay Utilities order needs an account at Paloma Verified level or above it, and a Paloma Bill Pay School Fees order needs an account at Paloma Verified Plus level or above it, together with a student reference.
